# Create HUD Text

Source: [4343](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4343); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Create HUD Text](../../api/actions/create-hud-text.md).

<a id="wiki-4343-n1"></a>

- HUD text persists until destroyed, exposes Last Text ID, and creation fails at text capacity.

<a id="wiki-4343-n2"></a>
